summary: Iteration 34 (Payment Modes Drawer + Monthly Revenue Report + Patient Timeline) fully verified end-to-end. Backend 9/9 pytest cases pass (drawer buckets Cash/UPI/Card correctly, revenue-report is owner-only + internally consistent counts.total==paid+pending+waived AND series sums match top-line totals, patient-timeline returns visits+receipts newest-first scoped to phone). Frontend rendered on mobile viewport (390x844): Collection screen shows 'Drawer by mode' with per-mode chips (Cash ₹1,600 · 4 txn, UPI ₹200 · 1 txn, Card ₹300 · 1 txn) and owner-only Month button (testID col-month) opens Revenue Report; Revenue screen renders Collected/Outstanding/Waived stat cards, counts line '7 encounters · 1 paid · 5 pending · 1 waived', legend and per-day stacked-bar breakdown; month stepper (rev-prev/rev-next) changes month. Timeline screen renders Visits/Paid/Due summary, tl-visit-<id> and tl-rcpt-<id> cards, entries scoped to the passed phone. Encounter detail encdet-timeline button navigates to timeline. Route ordering confirmed: /revenue-report, /patient-timeline, /collection-summary resolved BEFORE /{encounter_id}. Non-owner 403 negative test skipped per main agent note (no non-owner token seeded).

issues: On web preview the persistent left sidebar consumes ~50% of a 390-wide viewport, causing the 3 stat-card labels (Collected/Pending/Waived) to truncate to first letter. On a real mobile device (no sidebar) they render fine; still worth verifying stat labels fit at 320-360 widths without truncation.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'boxShadow'); 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use 'textShadow'); props.pointerEvents deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Not new to iteration 34 but repeats across every screen.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate deprecated RN Web style props (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents) to new API to clean console warnings.
(Optional) On very narrow widths, allow stat-card labels to wrap to 2 lines instead of numberOfLines={1} truncation.
critical_code_review_comments: encounters.py::revenue_report performs role check inline; consider extracting a require_owner_tier dep for consistency with other owner-gated endpoints.
encounters.py is 1127 lines — worth splitting billing/report handlers into a sub-module now that Iteration 34 adds more surface.
_drawer_by_mode uses receipt_date string equality; if any receipt is stored without receipt_date (older data) it will be excluded — verified acceptable for current dataset.
